text: Looking after my niece tonight, she's 2. Temp is 38.6, I've checked it twice with the ear thermometer to be sure. She keeps pointing at her throat and saying 'ow' when she swallows, so I'm assuming a sore throat, but she's still drinking her milk and water fine, she's had a full beaker since tea time. Her colour is normal, lips and skin look exactly like they always do, nothing odd there. Her mum's away until tomorrow and I'd rather not ring her in a panic over nothing, so I just need to know plainly: is this something I keep an eye on at home with Calpol and fluids, or does she need to be seen tonight? I don't need a long list of maybes, just tell me which one it is and what I should be watching for overnight.
